method: headless Chrome browser plus offline preview of the genuine saved student report
initial_driver_issue: The first browser driver expected two selections but submitted one because it filled the second search without explicitly clicking the dropdown. Clicking before filling resolved this in native controls; both products were then submitted in a separate browser run with all AI requests disabled. The original genuine output is unchanged.
limitations: One short live interview is not exhaustive behavioral evaluation.
Token usage is not collected by the student UI.
No numerical human rubric ratings have been assigned.
